summary: Keep each specification fact in exactly one authoritative document and reference or generate all other views from it (DRY docs / single source of truth); prohibit copy-paste duplication in doc review.

evidence.summary: 2026 SDD guide: versioned structured specifications as source of truth; community reports 60-80% fewer rework cycles vs prompt-driven development.
ADRs create a single durable source of truth per decision; decision log links to PRs/issues for traceability.

not_for: one-off documents that never get updated

risks: Link-only views reduce local readability; agents must be able to resolve references.
